tonight.headline: Lineup is right; Golden decides Thursday
body: Bad news first: Matthew Golden has not practised this week and Green Bay play Thursday. Bloodsports are 1-6.
The claims landed and the lineup as set is the projection lineup — 126.6 to Metcalf Gala's 121.2, 53%. The only live decision is Pickens for Golden if he is ruled out.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Metcalf Gala are set: Cook, Javonte Williams and St. Brown, with Olave benched on a Saints bye.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Golden out and the swap not made by 18:15 Thursday — 15 projected points become zero.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file 13:05Z · NBC Sports 27 Oct

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · Wednesday's report, then Thu 29 Oct 16:45 CDMX inactives
doFirst.title: If Golden is out, Pickens takes his WR slot
doFirst.subtitle: Carried from last night. Golden missed Monday and Tuesday; Green Bay's final report comes out this afternoon. If it says OUT, swap now; if questionable, wait for 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Shoulder plus a new foot injury; DNP Monday, non-participant in Tuesday's walkthrough (DK Network, PlayerProfiler 27 Oct). LaFleur on Tuesday night: 'still working through it' (NBC Sports 27 Oct 22:33Z).

case.label: The fallback
case.body: George Pickens, 14.0 — 1.1 below Golden, inside the coin-flip line, so nothing is given up by playing safe once Golden is in doubt. Lamb is healthy, so Pickens is Dallas's No. 2 against Arizona.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden plays Thursday and Pickens outscores him (archive) — that would say the contingency was right to exist but the check was mis-timed. If Golden sits, the call is untestable.

doFirst.sources: NBC Sports 27 Oct · PlayerProfiler 27 Oct · DK Network 27 Oct · lineup_check.py

whatWentWrong.title: Golden has not practised this week — and Green Bay play Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: DNP Monday, out of Tuesday's walkthrough, shoulder and foot. The final report is due this afternoon.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Golden played through the shoulder in Week 7 (12 targets, archive); the foot is new (PlayerProfiler 27 Oct). LaFleur would not commit Tuesday night.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Do-first fallback: Pickens in if Golden is ruled out, decided by 16:45 Thursday at the latest.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden practises fully Wednesday and is removed from the report.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Likely 3.2, Wilson 4.6 and the Jets D/ST 1 sank it; Gordon's 17.3 sat (archive). The margin was a roster gap, not a lineup one.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The roster is fuller now: Loveland and Daniels in, the Jaguars D/ST for the Jets. This week the lineup as set is the projection lineup — nothing to fix.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Bloodsports score below the league median again in Week 8 with the projection lineup — then STRATEGY §8's roster problem is still open.

case.label: The player
case.body: 11 catches, 218 yards, two TDs over two weeks while Garrett Wilson was quiet (NFL.com Week 8 waivers). The screen flags it efficiency-driven: his share fell from 37% to 23% in Week 7.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Xavier Worthy (8.2) would be the drop — but Worthy holds KC's top role while Rice is out, and his open thesis grades him against Strange in Week 8.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Six or more targets in Week 8 with Wilson active — then a free-agent add for Worthy, no priority spent.
